svg.title: The words you'll see in Hephaestus
svg.desc: Genome: like a recipe card sealed in plastic. One exact version of an agent: prompt, model, permissions. Any change makes a new one. World: like the exam and the exam-hall rules. The tasks, limits, judge, and rules an agent is measured against. Law: like a rule carved in stone. A World rule no agent can change, like “never read the judge.” Arena: like the exam hall. Two Genomes do identical tasks, each sealed in its own sandbox. Evaluator: like a judge behind a curtain. Scores every run. Agents never see it or the answers. Ledger: like a notebook with glued-in pages. The permanent record. Each entry is chained to the last, so edits show. Receipt: like a signed scorecard. Proof behind one decision: what ran, what it scored, and why. Champion: like the title holder. The version trusted as best for a World, until a challenger wins fairly. Freeze: like an emergency brake, on by default. Hephaestus starts paused. Only you can release it, and that is recorded too. Daemon: like the smith at the anvil. hephaestusd: does the work, and is the only writer to the Ledger.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Ten words, in plain English

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each one means exactly one thing, everywhere in Hephaestus.
